title: Bounded command envelopes for large repository inspection
failure_signature: Two repository inspection commands exceeded a ten-second orchestration envelope before returning authoritative state.
trigger_preconditions: multiple inspections sharing one short envelope
candidate_workaround: Split inspections by purpose, suppress unnecessary untracked enumeration where appropriate, and use a measured sixty-second ceiling without weakening the underlying check.
recurrence_guard: Use single-purpose commands and an envelope above the observed scan duration; never promote a timed-out batch as evidence.
rollback: Discard only the incomplete command result, retain its negative receipt, and reread authoritative Git or runner state directly.
scope_boundary: Repository inspection ergonomics only; not a validation waiver or scientific, security, or authority claim.
